capabilities: Upload pasted or dropped images to Qiniu object storage
Insert CDN links in place of local image attachments
Fall back to saving locally when an upload fails
Relay uploads through a self-hosted qiniuserver
Configure file name templates, upload paths, and size limits
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and warns that access/secret keys are stored in data.json inside the vault; users who sync or publish the vault are advised to ignore .obsidian or use relay mode so keys stay on their own server.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted and dropped images as local vault attachments, which bloats the vault and ties images to local files instead of hosted URLs.

requires.name: Qiniu Cloud account with access key, secret key, and bucket

summary: Uploads pasted or dropped images to Qiniu object storage and inserts the CDN link into the note instead of saving a local attachment.
